dynamic_factor.basis: PROTOTYPE: pulse field compression on top of the static hoop and inter-coil loads (D-21 would set it)

layers_m.basis: PROTOTYPE radial build between the winding and the burn-facing screen

armour_W_m.basis: CFC monoblock armour on Mo-TZM lithium tubes (durability.py: carbon is the only solid that survives every spectrum band at 4 J/cm2; conduction limits it to 5.7 mm at 7.8 MW/m2)

coolant_channel_m.basis: PROTOTYPE lithium channel behind the armour

LiH: lithium hydride, the SNAP-era space shadow-shield material (T02 LiH loop shoes); fast-neutron e-fold 0.12 m, band 0.08-0.18 (EXTRAPOLATION from removal cross sections); 600-700 K
WC_steel: tungsten carbide / B4C / steel; e-fold 0.10 m, band 0.07-0.15 (EXTRAPOLATION)

screens.basis: burn-facing neutron screen, warm loop; (density kg/m3, fast-neutron e-folding length m)

rebco_fluence_n_cm2.basis: SOURCE (order): REBCO critical current degrades above ~3e18 n/cm2 fast fluence (Prokopec et al. 2015, Fischer et al. 2018)

fluence_safety.basis: PROTOTYPE safety factor on the fluence limit

neutron_mean_MeV.basis: EXTRAPOLATION: mix of 2.45 MeV D-D and 14.1 MeV D-T neutrons

neutron_escape_factor.basis: FDP-1 uncollided escape exp(-tau_n); x10 sensitivity for scattered neutrons that leave the fuel

winding_deposit.basis: PROTOTYPE share of the neutron energy reaching the winding that deposits there

J_e_A_m2.basis: TARGET engineering current density of a REBCO winding pack (25 T class magnets 100-300 A/mm2)

winding_density.basis: PROTOTYPE winding pack density (REBCO tape, Cu stabiliser, steel, insulation), kg/m3

TARGET_composite: FDP-1 nozzle_kg_per_J 5.35e-7 kg/J (2x CFRP specific strength)
CFRP_1.2GPa: unidirectional CFRP hoop band, 1.2 GPa working stress at 20 K

case_options.basis: hoop structure options; mass = rho / sigma x 2 pi R T

strut_sigma.basis: CFRP strut working stress (axial coil loads)

strut_armour_m.basis: PROTOTYPE armour and screen on each strut face

foils.basis: PROTOTYPE reflective foils between armour back face and the warm screen (emissivity 0.1 each)

mli_80K_W_m2.basis: EXTRAPOLATION: MLI from a 628 K screen to an 80 K shield (1.5 W/m2 from 300 K scaled with T^4)

mli_20K_W_m2.basis: SOURCE (order): MLI from 80 K to 20 K

cryo_W_per_W_20K.basis: Carnot from 20 K to the 628 K warm loop at 30 % of Carnot

cryo_W_per_W_80K.basis: Carnot from 80 K to 628 K at 30 % of Carnot

li_dT_K.basis: PROTOTYPE coolant rise across the armour (1,500 to 1,800 K)

pump_kg_per_W.basis: EXTRAPOLATION: 1 kg/kW electric for large EM pumps

pipe_kg_per_m3_flow.basis: Mo-TZM tubes of 0.15 m radius, wall r/50 (1 MPa, 50 MPa creep allowable at 1,800 K), min 2 mm

cryo_kg_per_W_in.basis: EXTRAPOLATION: cryoplant mass per watt of input, turbo-Brayton TARGET and conservative

shadow_cone_T_K.basis: alternative coil radiators in the coils own shadow cone
